verdict.rationale: Extend documents an official MCP server and Agent Quickstart, which allow AI agents/assistants to drive the platform via natural-language tool calls rather than raw API calls, and it also ships a CLI for programmatic control. However, there is no first-party example or independent corroboration showing an end-user issuing free-form natural-language commands and Extend interpreting/executing them directly. Missing for 10: concrete examples of natural-language command execution, independent/hands-on validation of the MCP/agent workflow.
